title.rendered: Triple Science VS Combined Science: What To Choose?

excerpt.rendered: Deciding between Triple Science and Combined Science is an important choice for IGCSE students. Triple Science covers Biology, Chemistry, and Physics as separate subjects, offering a deeper understanding of each. Meanwhile, Combined Science merges these subjects into one course, providing a broad overview at a slightly easier pace. Both options have their benefits depending on the student’s interest and future academic plans.

title.rendered: IB Curriculum VS British Curriculum: Which Path Is Better?

excerpt.rendered: Key Summary Philosophy:IB focuses on holistic, inquiry-based learning with global exposure, while the British Curriculum follows a structured, subject-focused approach. Curriculum Structure:IB follows PYP → MYP → DP/CP; the British Curriculum follows Key Stages → GCSEs → A-Levels. excerpt.rendered: As students navigate their high school years, Whether Advanced Placement (AP) exams are hard often comes to mind.
